records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Following up on our onboarding call last week. The two steps that usually make Wrenfield click are creating a first project and inviting a teammate 
invites go out from Account Settings -> Members at any time. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first one is worth getting on paper.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that came up since we spoke.

Best,
Priya
